0.0: What up? You need to get up on the repair tip?\r\n#L0##bI would like to get a friend of mine a gift. Do you have any ideas?#l\n#k
0.1: Aww, man, I'm super jelly! The only gift worth gettin' is sweet new gadgets. What's your friend like?\r\n#L0##bI... don't really know. He enjoys bears and is a 'gearhead'.#l\n#k
0.2: Like, grizzly bears?\r\n#L0##bHe generally wears a teddy bear suit.#l\n#k
0.3: Oh. That's not as cool as I was imagining. Maybe he's just really into teddy bears. You say he wears a suit?\r\n#L0##bI have heard that he never removes it.#l\n#k
0.4: That's some straight-up willpower! You should get that dude #ba hand-made teddy bear#k. Or maybe like a one-of-a-kind doll?\r\n#L0##bYou believe he would enjoy this?#l\n#k
0.5: You know, a doll that can maybe walk on its own or like fly around with a propeller hat? Maybe one that transforms into a badger, but then the badger is also a sound engineer that specializes in dropping the bass? \r\n#L0##bI think you're getting a little carried away.#l\n#k
0.6: Whatever, maybe I'll make my own flying badger DJ. I'll make your buddy a doll too, if you get me the stuff.
